title: Eventual flatness of a fixed module on a base-change stage
statement: In the affine directed Noetherian system of lem-pc-flat-module-descent, fix i <= j and X_i of finite presentation over Spec R_i [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. For a fixed finitely presented quasicoherent module M on X_j, if its moduleBaseChange to X is flat over the limit base, there is l >= j such that its moduleBaseChange to every X_k with k >= l is flat over Spec R_k [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Neither M nor any differential is reselected.

proof.text: With starting scheme X_j and structure morphism f_j:X_j -> Spec R_j, compare moduleBaseChange to the canonical iterated pullback using the cartesian baseChangeMap square. Transport the assumed limit flatness.
Apply exists_eventually_isFlatOver_of_limit at starting index j. The structure map f_j is a base change of f and is finitely presented.

For each k beyond the obtained threshold, use the same cartesian-model comparison to turn its iterated-pullback flatness conclusion into flatness of moduleBaseChange f applied to the original fixed M.

theorem exists_eventually_isFlatOver_staged_module
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (M : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
      (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj M).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i)))) :
    ∃ l : I, ∃ hjl : j ≤ l, ∀ (k : I) (hlk : l ≤ k),
      ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjl.trans hlk))))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hjl.trans hlk))))
          (by simp [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]))).obj M).IsFlatOver
            (pullback.snd f
              (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjl.trans hlk))))))
